name: Label Studio
description: Multi-type data labeling and annotation tool for machine learning with support for text, images, audio, and video.

env.label: Admin Email
env.description: Email address for the initial admin account

env.label: Admin Password
env.description: Password for the initial admin account

env.label: Disable Public Signup
env.description: Disable public signup; users can only register with an invitation link

env.label: Enable Local File Serving
env.description: Allow serving local files for labeling tasks (enable if importing from local storage)

env.label: Local Files Root Path
env.description: Root directory for local file serving (must be an absolute path inside the container)

env.label: Database Backend
env.description: Database backend to use (default is SQLite, use postgresql for production)

env.label: External Host URL
env.description: External URL where Label Studio is accessible (e.g. https://label-studio.example.com)
